title: Spontaneously directed loop extrusion in SMC complexes emerges from broken detailed balance and anisotropic DNA search.
authors: Bonato, Andrea; Jang, Jae-Won; Kim, Do-Gyun; Moon, Kyoung-Wook; Michieletto, Davide; Ryu, Je-Kyung
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AFM和计算模拟研究酵母凝缩素SMC复合物铰链域各向异性DNA捕获驱动环挤压定向性的机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作与动态机理建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: DNA loop formation by structural maintenance of chromosome (SMC) proteins, including cohesin, condensin, and the SMC5/6 complex, plays a pivotal role in genome organization. Despite its importance, the molecular mechanism underlying SMC-mediated loop formation, particularly how these complexes achieve persistent directionality (rectification) while minimizing backward steps during the formation of large loops, remains poorly understood. Here, we use atomic force microscopy (AFM) and computational simulation to uncover a key geometric feature of the yeast condensin SMC complex enabling rectified loop growth. Using AFM, we demonstrate that the hinge domain of yeast condensin exhibits a directional bias, extending orthogonally to the bound DNA and sampling an anisotropic region of space around the protein complex. By accounting for the geometric constraint on the hinge-mediated DNA-capture step, we computationally show that loop growth can spontaneously self-rectify. In contrast, an SMC model with broken detailed balance and isotropic search instead exhibited substantial loop shrinkage and random-walk-like behaviour. These findings reveal an overlooked, and potentially broadly conserved, anisotropic DNA capture mechanism through which SMC complexes form and stabilize DNA loops in vivo, in turn providing novel insights into the physical principles governing genome organization.
abstract_zh: 由结构维护染色体（SMC）蛋白（包括黏连蛋白、凝缩蛋白和SMC5/6复合物）介导的DNA环形成在基因组组织中发挥关键作用。尽管其重要性，SMC介导的环形成背后的分子机制，特别是这些复合物如何在形成大环时实现持续方向性（整流）并最小化后退步骤，仍知之甚少。在此，我们使用原子力显微镜（AFM）和计算模拟揭示了酵母凝缩蛋白SMC复合物的一个关键几何特征，该特征使得环生长得以整流。通过AFM，我们证明酵母凝缩蛋白的铰链结构域表现出方向性偏好，正交延伸至结合的DNA，并在蛋白质复合物周围采样各向异性的空间区域。通过考虑铰链介导的DNA捕获步骤的几何约束，我们在计算上表明环生长可以自发地自我整流。相反，具有破坏详细平衡和各向同性搜索的SMC模型则表现出显著的环收缩和随机游走样行为。这些发现揭示了一种被忽视且可能广泛保守的各向异性DNA捕获机制，SMC复合物通过该机制在体内形成并稳定DNA环，进而为调控基因组组织的物理原理提供了新见解。
